headline: Vale Shares Gain 1.2% in New York Despite Soft Chinese Steel Demand
summary: American depositary receipts of Brazilian mining giant Vale rose 1.22% to $11.59 on Friday, marking a third straight gain despite persistent weakness in Chinese steel demand.
why: Vale is the world's largest producer of iron ore pellets and nickel, highly exposed to Chinese industrial demand.

impacts.name: Vale S.A.
impacts.why: Bargain buying lifted Vale ADRs despite long-term headwinds in Chinese iron ore consumption.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-day technical rebound in Latin American mining equities supported Vale's stock recovery.
